summary: Pieces of the size series exist in separate archives — BacDive strain morphology (shape class, dimensions; API returns JSON for single IDs without login), IDR cell images, Zenodo/Dryad single-taxon cell size-shape tables, and MorphoSource 3D scans (mostly bones) at the large end — but no dataset records outline geometry under a common protocol across cells and whole organisms, and the key variable, the residual of each form from a surface-tension (constant-mean-curvature) surface, is not stored anywhere and would have to be computed. AlgaeBase's API needs a key (401).
next_step: Compile a cross-scale panel: segmented outlines from IDR cells, BacDive dimensions, coccolithophore/ciliate sets, and whole-body meshes (MorphoSource or Sketchfab-type scans) with size; then pre-register the fit-residual-vs-size cutoff test.
obstacles_confirmed: Shape class is not a fit residual to a surface-tension surface.
The three archives do not share a common morphometric protocol.
